【How to create an account?】

To get started, simply click the "REGISTER" button on our homepage. Once registered, you can easily top up your account by clicking "DEPOSIT" or withdraw your funds by clicking "WITHDRAW"

 

【Can i register multiple accounts?】

Multiple account registration is strictly prohibited. Any violation of this policy will result in account restrictions and the forfeiture of associated benefits.

 

【What are the deposit and withdraw limits?】

The minimum deposit amount is AUD 10 and the minimum withdrawal amount is AUD 30 (excluding applied bonuses).

Deposits require a x1 Rollover on the total bet, and withdrawal.

No Maximum Withdrawal Amount.

 

【Can I get someone else or a third party to do the deposit transaction for me?】

The full name of the deposit account must match the registered full name, and the company does not accept any third-party payment

 

【What is our ROLLOVER and WINOVER ?】

Different companies have different abbreviations and rules, But in our company there are only rollover and winover , all according to the following instructions.

✵ ROLLOVER : Total Bet In Game.

✵ WINOVER : Minimum Withdraw / Final Remain Credit.

【Can i Claim Different Bonus at the same time?】

Applying for multiple promotions, bonuses, rebates, commissions, angpao, or free games simultaneously is prohibited.

Violating withdrawal rules may result in forfeiture of the bonus, despite multiple bonuses being available.

 

【Why do games platforms sometimes disappear?】

To ensure optimal gaming experience, game platforms may undergo maintenance from time to time.

During such periods, the game platform may be temporarily unavailable on the website, but once the necessary repairs and updates are completed, it will be restored to the website, providing players with a seamless and immersive gaming environment.

To safeguard the security of our customer's bank accounts, we adhere to a stringent policy regarding any changes to registered accounts. Unless an account is frozen or blocked, any requests to modify a bank account will require thorough verification and submission of supporting documents to ensure authenticity and protect against fraudulent activity.

 

【What should i do if i cannot receive the verification code?】

To register a new user or retrieve a forgotten password, users must request a verification code.However, sometimes the verification code may not be received, posing a security risk.

To mitigate this, users are unable to directly request assistance through live chat. Instead, our services team will provide two secure methods to verify membership authenticity for support purposes.
